source:
@@U03870@@
I fear this union Will not be for long.

@@U03872@@
Bridle this longing! Think of your parents! Think how they love you! Bridle this mad, Impetuous longing! Stay with us here In this quiet country!
translation:
@@U03870@@
我担心这个联盟不会长久。

@@U03872@@
抑制住这种渴望！想想你的父母！想想他们多么爱你！勒住这疯狂、浮躁的渴望！和我们一起在这个安静的国家！
